title: Restore standard GitHub Actions validation triggers
description:
GitHub Actions were temporarily restricted while release automation was being repaired. Restore the repository validation workflows to their established pull-request and branch triggers without redesigning the workflows or changing release credentials.

Acceptance:
- The restored triggers match the last intentional enabled configuration.
- Workflow YAML parses successfully.
- The change remains separate from release-authentication redesign.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation started. Scope is limited to reversing the four temporary .bak renames from commit 7f3bf775d; release authentication and workflow redesign are explicitly deferred. The workflow-enabled specification failed first because ci.yaml was disabled.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Restored the four standard workflow filenames as exact 100 percent renames reversing the temporary disable commit; no trigger, credential, or workflow-body redesign was included. Validation: workflow contract tests parse all four enabled YAML files and confirm no backup filenames remain; focused suite passes 8 of 8 and diff check passes.
